title: If...
description: A picture lesson on conditional sentences with 'if'. Six pictures show different scenarios: if it rains tomorrow (stay home / go to the seaside), if you are ill next week (see a doctor / ask a friend), if you can't make up your mind (retire / travel to England). The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 137 dialogue), B (write 'if' sentences like the example), and C (answer questions with 'if' clauses). The workbook drills 'if' sentence completion and open-ended 'About you' writing; the grammar workbook completes 'if' dialogue items, writes 'if' sentences about the future, and chooses the correct 'if' words.
answer_note: The listening captions are model answers (suggested). Textbook written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 137 dialogue), B (write 'if' sentences), and C (answer with 'if' clauses) are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (complete 'if' sentences) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-135-141.jpg p.217); Workbook B ('About you') has no printed key, so the answers are model answers (suggested). Grammar I (complete 'if' dialogue), II (write 'if' sentences), and III (choose the correct words) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.577).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. If it rains tomorrow, she'll stay at home. / If it rains tomorrow, she may stay at home.
2. If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go to the seaside. / If it's nice at the weekend, he may go to the seaside.
3. If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor. / If you are ill next week, you may see a doctor.
4. If you can't make up your mind, she'll ask a friend. / If you can't make up your mind, she may ask a friend.
5. If you don't get the job, he'll retire. / If you don't get the job, he may retire.
6. If you win a lot of money, you'll travel to England. / If you win a lot of money, you may travel to England.
lesson.translation: 1. 如果明天下雨，她将待在家里。/ 如果明天下雨，她可能待在家里。 2. 如果周末天气好，他将去海边。/ 如果周末天气好，他可能去海边。 3. 如果你下周生病了，你将去看医生。/ 如果你下周生病了，你可能去看医生。 4. 如果你拿不定主意，她将问一个朋友。/ 如果你拿不定主意，她可能问一个朋友。 5. 如果你得不到那份工作，他将退休。/ 如果你得不到那份工作，他可能退休。 6. 如果你赢了大笔钱，你将去英国旅行。/ 如果你赢了大笔钱，你可能去英国旅行。

grammar.title: Grammar I: Complete the sentences with 'if' or 'when'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句完成以下句子（用 if 或 when）。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句完成以下句子（用 if 或 when）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.577 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 'if'/'when' fill-in items; item 1 (We may go to the seaside this weekend. (if, go) → If we go to the seaside this weekend, we'll have a good time.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: We may go to the seaside this weekend. (if, go)
questions.answer: If we go to the seaside this weekend, we'll have a good time.

questions.prompt: I may be ill next week. (if, ill)
questions.answer: If I am ill next week, I'll see a doctor.

questions.prompt: They may win the prize. (if, win)
questions.answer: If they win the prize, they'll travel abroad.

questions.prompt: She may not come to the party. (if, not come)
questions.answer: If she doesn't come to the party, we'll have a good time anyway.

questions.prompt: He may get the job. (if, get)
questions.answer: If he gets the job, he'll celebrate with a dinner.

questions.prompt: We may not have enough time. (if, not have)
questions.answer: If we don't have enough time, we'll leave early.

questions.prompt: It may rain tomorrow. (if, rain)
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.

questions.prompt: They may not reach the top. (if, not reach)
questions.answer: If they don't reach the top, they'll try again next year.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Choose the correct words

questions.prompt: If it (rain / rains) tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
questions.answer: rains

questions.prompt: If you (be / are) ill, you'll see a doctor.
questions.answer: are

questions.prompt: If they (win / wins) the prize, they'll travel abroad.
questions.answer: win

questions.prompt: If he (get / gets) the job, he'll celebrate.
questions.answer: gets

questions.prompt: If we (not have / don't have) enough time, we'll leave early.

questions.prompt: If it (rain / rains) tomorrow, we'll stay at home.

questions.prompt: If they (not reach / don't reach) the top, they'll try again.
questions.answer: don't reach

questions.answer: win

questions.prompt: If they (win / wins) the contract, we'll open a branch.
